skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the origins, concepts, and economic-social roles of insurance.

Grasp key principles of insurance including majority-minority principle, premium-benefit principle, absolute honesty principle, risk selection principle, insurable interest principle, indemnity principle, and proximate cause principle.

Comprehend various types of insurance policies, their objects, scopes, fund formation, business operations, and implementation of social insurance, health insurance, unemployment insurance, and other types of insurance.
Understand insurance transaction processes such as claim requests, insurance forms, certificates, renewals, sales, premiums, complaints, and complaint resolution.
Learn about communication activities in insurance and the necessity and selection of information technology in insurance operations.
